synopsis: Chapter 12 and the glossary agree that Product Liability Directive (EU) 2024/2853 applies to products placed on the market after 9 December 2026 [f9802, f15064]. Chapter 12 states that the directive defines software as a product [f9803]. It also identifies a potential litigation risk: the programme’s evidence records may be disclosable in the directive’s product-liability context, although this is presented as expert opinion rather than a definite disclosure requirement [f9804].

relations.note: Chapter 12 and the glossary state the same market-placement applicability date.
Software’s product status supports the programme’s potential exposure to product-liability evidence disclosure.
